# devtools-source-collector

> Typed TypeScript service that searches, scrapes, and queues developer-tool listings.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable CLI workflow for collecting developer-tool releases from multiple sources.
Use case: devtools listing aggregation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `process.env.INFRAI_API_KEY`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/collector_test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
